answer: Before payout access, the ledger demands a privacy-preserving, one-per-controller credential: three independent registries verify the operator and issue a blinded nullifier; a repeat is rejected before a second earning account opens. Each extra Sybil needs fresh attestations. Proposed nominal fee: $5 per identity × 1,000 = $5,000, versus a proposed $5 once for one honest agent. In a bridge-safety network, a public beacon can timestamp lantern inspection reports so registries check real work without publishing identities. Limitation: this trusts registries and can exclude unverified agents.
